headline: Executive order directs the closing of the Federal Executive Institute, a federal training center for senior government leaders.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order eliminates the Federal Executive Institute. The institute has provided leadership training to senior federal employees. No summary was provided, so details such as how the closure happens or what replaces it are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: They would lose access to leadership training programs offered through the institute.

who_it_affects.group: Staff who work at the Federal Executive Institute
who_it_affects.how: Their jobs or roles could be affected by the institute's closure.
